scope: Use the validated canonical positive delivery fact, or the existing Task delivered_once fact, at the existing Intake.revise, external.approve_prose_revision and submit(parent_task_id) predicates. Preserve their existing validation position and exception type. A missing canonical row is not proof of safe historical eligibility. Do not block provider observations, rewrite Task during lookup, change public schemas, or add a production follow-up issuer.

case_added.basis: Lead-approved monotone delivery fence for new scope authority and linked follow-up eligibility
controls: A complete authored provider history proves Done followed by remote Todo reset. Recording the observation retains byte-identical Task/version/flags. New exact-approved local scope revision refuses with InvalidTransition and no new task/outbox/attempt/resource/provider effect.

After that positive fact, a genuine external prose observation remains recordable. New staged scope approval refuses with the existing EvidenceRequired class while the original prose remains unchanged.

A canonical-positive parent with delivered_once=false still requires exact delivered_followup evidence. Missing or wrong evidence refuses without effect. Explicit synthetic trusted fixture evidence permits a separate linked Backlog task only; this does not claim any implemented production issuer.
A committed same-key scope revision replays after a later canonical delivered fact without a new effect. A new operation refuses. No authority, delivery fact or resource is released by replay.
Invalid canonical fact encodings refuse rather than becoming false; missing canonical facts alone do not establish a historical negative. Existing Task delivered_once remains positive authority.
